hec.lang

Interface LoggingConstants

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    Logger

    public interface LoggingConstants
    this interface defines the debug flags used and the debug levels used by hec.lang.Logger To add a debug flag to the system just add a public static final String to the list of flags. hec.lang.Logger will pick them up at runtime via reflection.
